siteContent.heroHeadline: Transforming Business Processes Into Intelligent Automated Systems.
siteContent.heroSupportingText: I design and build intelligent automation solutions that connect applications, eliminate repetitive tasks, and help businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
siteContent.aboutHeadline: I build systems that do the repetitive work, so people can do the meaningful work.
aboutBioParagraphs: I am Chukwuma Jefferson Nnaji, an AI Automation Specialist and Workflow Automation Engineer operating under SWIZZCONCEPTS from Enugu, Nigeria. My work centers on turning fragmented, manual operational steps into reliable, self-running workflows powered by APIs, structured data pipelines, and large language models.

My technical foundation was built through intensive formal AI and Automation training at TS Academy, where I mastered visual orchestration across n8n, Make.com, and Zapier alongside REST APIs, webhooks, CRM pipelines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

During my practical internship at Big Brains, I moved from classroom theory into production-oriented engineering—designing, testing, and debugging end-to-end automation systems including an AI-powered Lead Qualification CRM that scores, classifies, and routes incoming prospects automatically.

projects.title: RAG-Powered AI Knowledge Assistant
projects.overview: A retrieval-augmented AI assistant built to answer complex operational and policy questions using verified internal documents rather than generic model guesses.
projects.businessProblem: Teams waste valuable time digging through scattered PDFs, SOP documents, and shared folders to locate accurate answers to recurring operational questions.
projects.solutionImplemented: Engineered an automated document ingestion and retrieval pipeline in n8n paired with vector embeddings and structured LLM prompting so every response is grounded in indexed source chunks.
workflowSteps: Document upload or update triggers ingestion webhook
Text extracted, split into semantic chunks, and embedded into vector store
User query triggers similarity search for top matching context passages
LLM synthesizes grounded response with fallback when context is missing
projects.workflowExplanation: The system separates ingestion from querying: whenever source documentation changes, an n8n indexing flow updates the vector store automatically. At query time, user questions are embedded, matched against stored vectors, and passed into a strict prompt template that restricts answers to retrieved facts.
projects.businessValue: Centralizes institutional knowledge into a single queryable interface, reducing internal search friction and improving answer consistency across staff.

projects.title: AI-Powered Audit Report Generator
projects.overview: An automated assessment and reporting pipeline that converts raw audit intake submissions into structured, client-ready diagnostic reports.
projects.businessProblem: Preparing tailored workflow or operational audit reports manually after discovery questionnaires requires hours of repetitive synthesis and formatting.
projects.solutionImplemented: Connected Fillout/Tally intake forms via webhooks to an n8n AI analysis workflow that scores findings, generates structured recommendations, and delivers formatted audit summaries.
workflowSteps: Client completes structured audit assessment form
Webhook delivers JSON answers to n8n orchestration engine
AI agent evaluates bottlenecks and drafts structured gap-analysis sections
Formatted report archived in Google Sheets and emailed automatically
projects.workflowExplanation: Form responses trigger a multi-node evaluation pipeline. A JavaScript normalization node scores numeric readiness inputs while an LLM drafts tailored process recommendations constrained to a strict JSON schema before compiling the final report.
projects.businessValue: Shortens report turnaround time from hours of manual drafting to minutes while ensuring consistent diagnostic structure for every prospect.

projects.title: Telegram Bot Reply
projects.overview: An AI-powered Telegram search assistant that answers questions in real time like a conversational search engine using live web results and chat memory.
projects.businessProblem: Users often leave chat threads to manually look up current facts across search engines, losing conversational context and speed.
projects.solutionImplemented: Built an n8n AI Agent triggered by Telegram messages, paired with Google Gemini Chat Model, Simple Memory for follow-up context, and live SerpApi Google Search and Tavily search tools.
workflowSteps: Incoming user question arrives through the Telegram Trigger node
AI Agent retrieves prior conversation turns from Simple Memory
Agent queries Google Search (SerpApi) or Tavily for live information
Google Gemini synthesizes a clear reply and sends it back on Telegram
projects.workflowExplanation: Every Telegram message enters an n8n AI Agent powered by Google Gemini, session-based Simple Memory, and live search tool nodes (SerpApi Google Search and Tavily). The agent decides when to query live web results, grounds its reasoning in retrieved snippets, and replies directly in Telegram.
projects.businessValue: Transforms Telegram into an instant, conversational search engine with up-to-date web answers and multi-turn memory.

projects.title: Daily Business Intelligence Reporter
projects.overview: A scheduled automation pipeline that aggregates daily operational metrics from databases and spreadsheets into concise executive briefings.
projects.businessProblem: Decision-makers frequently lack a single daily snapshot because sales, support, and task metrics live across separate spreadsheets and apps.
projects.solutionImplemented: Designed a cron-scheduled workflow that queries Airtable, Google Sheets, and CRM endpoints, computes daily deltas via JavaScript, and delivers an AI-summarized briefing to Slack and Gmail.
workflowSteps: Scheduled trigger runs at end-of-day cutoff
HTTP & database nodes pull daily leads, tickets, and activity records
JavaScript node calculates totals and flags anomalies
LLM summarizes highlights and dispatches formatted digest to Slack and email
projects.workflowExplanation: Instead of raw spreadsheet dumps, the workflow performs deterministic arithmetic first in JavaScript, then passes verified aggregate figures to an LLM solely to produce clear prose commentary delivered to leadership channels.
projects.businessValue: Replaces manual end-of-day spreadsheet compilation with a reliable, repeatable executive summary every morning.

projects.title: Automated Job Application Tracker
projects.overview: An email-driven tracking automation that monitors job application confirmations, interview invitations, and status updates into a structured database.
projects.businessProblem: Tracking dozens of active applications across email threads quickly leads to missed follow-ups, lost links, and disorganized spreadsheets.
projects.solutionImplemented: Connected Gmail triggers to an AI information-extraction pipeline that parses company name, role title, application stage, and next steps directly into Airtable and Google Sheets.
workflowSteps: New inbox message matching application keywords triggers pipeline
AI classifier filters out newsletters and extracts structured job metadata
Upsert logic checks Airtable for existing company/role record
Record created or stage updated with interview dates and email summary
projects.workflowExplanation: Incoming emails are filtered and passed through an information-extraction prompt returning strict JSON (company, role, status, action_date). An upsert routine updates existing rows instead of creating duplicates.
projects.businessValue: Maintains an always-current, searchable application pipeline with zero manual spreadsheet entry.

projects.title: Airline Travel Notification Automation
projects.overview: A real-time flight monitoring and traveler alert workflow that checks itinerary status via REST APIs and sends proactive departure or delay notifications.
projects.businessProblem: Travelers and coordinators miss gate changes, schedule shifts, or check-in windows when relying on manual airline portal checks.
projects.solutionImplemented: Integrated flight status REST API polling with conditional state comparison in n8n to push timely updates over Telegram, WhatsApp, and Gmail.
workflowSteps: Active flight records queried from schedule table on interval
HTTP Request node fetches live flight status JSON from aviation API
Conditional node detects gate, delay, or boarding status changes
Formatted travel alert dispatched instantly to traveler channel
projects.workflowExplanation: To avoid noisy repeat messages, the workflow compares the latest API payload against the last recorded flight state in storage and fires notifications strictly on meaningful status transitions.
projects.businessValue: Delivers proactive itinerary visibility and reduces missed updates for travelers and operations coordinators.

projects.title: B2B Lead Generation and Qualification
projects.overview: An AI-powered Lead Qualification CRM pipeline engineered during my Big Brains internship to capture, score, classify, and route B2B prospects automatically.
projects.businessProblem: Manual lead triage slows down response speed and causes sales teams to spend equal time on unqualified inquiries and high-fit B2B opportunities.
projects.solutionImplemented: Built an end-to-end n8n workflow linking lead capture forms and enrichment APIs with LLM lead scoring, structured classification, and HubSpot/Airtable CRM record management.
workflowSteps: Inbound B2B prospect submits qualification form or enrichment webhook fires
JavaScript normalizes company domain and contact metadata
AI scoring engine assigns fit tier, urgency, and concise qualification rationale
CRM record created/updated in HubSpot and Airtable with Slack alert for hot leads
projects.workflowExplanation: Prompt engineering rules evaluate company size, stated pain points, and service alignment against defined ICP criteria. High-priority leads trigger instant Slack notifications with a pre-drafted outreach brief.
projects.businessValue: Standardizes lead qualification criteria and ensures high-intent B2B inquiries receive rapid, well-informed follow-up.

projects.title: Swizz Care Feedback & Service
projects.overview: An automated customer feedback collection, sentiment classification, and service recovery system built under the SWIZZCONCEPTS ecosystem.
projects.businessProblem: Unreviewed customer feedback forms hide urgent dissatisfaction signals and miss opportunities to resolve service issues promptly.
projects.solutionImplemented: Connected Tally/Fillout feedback forms to an AI sentiment and urgency classifier that logs categorized insights in Airtable and routes negative feedback for immediate follow-up.
workflowSteps: Customer submits post-service feedback through Tally form
AI classification analyzes sentiment, topic category, and urgency
Structured feedback stored in Airtable service dashboard
Urgent issues trigger instant service-recovery alert; positive feedback receives thank-you note
projects.workflowExplanation: By pairing lightweight form collection with deterministic routing rules, positive reviews are archived cleanly while negative or urgent entries immediately notify the service lead with actionable context.
projects.businessValue: Closes the feedback loop automatically and prevents critical customer service concerns from going unnoticed.

projects.title: Telegram Delivery Bot Reply
projects.overview: A responsive Telegram logistics assistant that processes customer delivery inquiries, looks up dispatch records, and sends structured status replies.
projects.businessProblem: Delivery teams spend repetitive hours answering "where is my order?" messages manually across chat threads.
projects.solutionImplemented: Integrated Telegram Bot webhooks with an Airtable/Google Sheets dispatch lookup and AI-formatted natural-language status replies.
workflowSteps: Customer sends tracking reference or delivery question to Telegram bot
Information extraction pulls order ID or phone reference from message
Workflow queries dispatch sheet/Airtable for current delivery milestone
Bot replies with clear status, ETA context, or dispatch escalation
projects.workflowExplanation: Combines regex/AI entity extraction with a real-time lookup against the active dispatch table so customers receive accurate, polite delivery updates in seconds without interrupting dispatch staff.
projects.businessValue: Reduces repetitive manual chat replies for dispatch teams and gives customers instant order transparency.

projects.title: AI Lead Qualification System
projects.overview: An end-to-end automated CRM lead validation, AI scoring, tiered routing, and scheduled multi-channel follow-up system built in n8n with Anthropic Claude and Google Sheets.
projects.businessProblem: Sales teams lose pipeline momentum when raw CRM leads arrive with missing contact fields, inconsistent scoring criteria, and delayed manual follow-ups across Hot, Warm, Cold, and Unqualified tiers.
projects.solutionImplemented: Engineered a dual-trigger n8n orchestration pipeline that cleans incoming CRM records, separates complete vs. incomplete leads for automated data-completion outreach, scores qualified leads via Anthropic Chat Model with Structured Output Parsers, and routes Hot, Warm, Cold, and Unqualified tiers into dedicated CRM updates and sales alerts.
workflowSteps: Scheduled triggers poll CRM leads and pending follow-up queues from Google Sheets
JavaScript validation cleans records and routes incomplete leads to automated follow-up channels
Anthropic LLM Chains with Structured Output Parsers score fit and assign qualification status
Switch routing classifies Hot, Warm, Cold, and Unqualified leads, notifying sales and updating CRM rows
projects.workflowExplanation: The architecture separates scheduled follow-up execution from live lead qualification. Incoming CRM rows are normalized in JavaScript and checked for completeness; incomplete records trigger automated Gmail or HTTP follow-up nudges, while complete leads pass through Anthropic Basic LLM Chains paired with Structured Output Parsers to produce deterministic lead scores and tier labels (Hot, Warm, Cold, Unqualified) before updating the main CRM and alerting sales.
projects.businessValue: Eliminates manual lead sorting and follow-up delays, ensuring incomplete prospects are re-engaged automatically while sales receives instant alerts only for qualified, prioritized leads.
